kal payment kar diya
paid ho gaya
payment already hua
mai ne payment kar diya
paise kat gaye

items.context: Kya aapne payment kar diya hai?
items.text: haan ji

items.context: Kya aap confirm kar sakte hain ki payment ho chuka hai?
items.text: paid ho gaya

items.context: Payment process hone me kitna time lagega?
items.text: abhi transfer ho raha hai
mera account se paise kat gaye lekin payment nahi hua
maine 15 february ko payment bank se kiya tha
transfer receipt mere paas hai aap verify kar sakte hain
maine 2000 rupees ka payment already kar diya tha kal
payment confirmation message bhi mujhe aaya tha
mere pass transaction id hai jise aap dekh sakte hain
placeholder payment hua hai par details update nahi hua abhi tak

items.context: Kab ki payment ki thi aapne?
items.text: maine 5 march ko payment bank draft ke through ki thi

items.context: Kya aapke paas payment confirmation ka message hai?
items.text: meri taraf se payment ki confirmation message bhi aayi thi

items.context: Kitna amount transfer kiya tha aapne?
items.text: maine net banking se 2500 ka transfer kiya tha

items.context: Kya aapke paas koi payment receipt hai?
items.text: poster payment ki receipt mere paas available hai

items.context: Kya aapke paas transaction ID hai verify karwane ke liye?
items.text: transaction ID dena chahunga verify ke liye
maine last month payment kar diya tha lekin ab tak account me reflect nahi hua hai
paise mere account se deduct ho gaye the par payment confirmation aapke taraf se nahi aayi
mera naam Arun Sharma hai aur maine 3000 rupees ki payment ki thi 10 april ko

items.context: Kya aapne payment ki receipt humse share ki hai verify karne ke liye?
items.text: maine payment mai ne account se ki thi receipt upload kar di hai par verify nahi hua abhi tak

items.context: Kya aapke account se paise deduct ho gaye hain?
items.text: mere account se payment reduce ho gaya tha lekin aapko payment show nahi hua hai kya karun

items.context: Kab aapne payment kiya tha aur koi transaction id hai?
items.text: maine kal 12 baje bank transfer kiya tha uska transaction id aap verify kar sakte hain

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: already_paid - says they have already paid and gives details
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
